From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Sent: Thursday, November 6, 2014 5:05 PM
To: Jim Murray <jim@excelsm.com>
Subject: Re: Introducing myself 
 
Hey Jim,
Thank you for the response. I received your message earlier but was out of pocket.
I'll be in touch in the coming weeks.

Anthony
From: Jim Murray <jim@excelsm.com>
Sent: Thursday, November 6, 2014 8:01 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: Re: Introducing myself 
 
Anthony,
I apologize for the late response.  It has been a busy first few days of Free Agency.  I will give you a call later today or tomorrow.  Welcome to the Tigers beat.
If you have any immediate questions, email is probably the best way to reach me.  Thanks.

*************************************
Jim Murray
Excel Sports Management
1700 Broadway, 29th Floor
New York, NY 10019
Main: 646.454.5900
Direct: 646.454.5918
Email: jim@excelsm.com

From: <Fenech>, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Date: Wednesday, October 22, 2014 at 4:58 PM
To: James Murray <jim@excelsm.com>
Subject: Introducing myself
My name is Anthony Fenech and I cover the Tigers for the Detroit Free Press.
I'm writing to introduce myself because I'm new to the beat and I’m reaching out with the hopes of starting a network.
Free agency is right around the corner so I wanted to reach out before things get too hectic.
Look forward to getting in in touch.
